create_KMeansQuantizer: create a KMeansQuantizer instance by loading a kmeans model from a checkpoint path
run_KMeansQuantizer_forward: run the KMeansQuantizer forward pass to predict cluster assignments for input tensor x
get_KMeansQuantizer_vocab_size: get the vocabulary size (number of clusters) from a KMeansQuantizer instance
load_kmeans_model_static: load a kmeans model from a checkpoint file using the static load_kmeans_model method
get_KMeansQuantizer_device: get the device of a KMeansQuantizer instance via its device property
